newsitem.title: USA: Cablevision to launch Internet link.
newsitem.headline: Cablevision to launch Internet link.

text.p: Cablevision Systems Corp said Tuesday it plans to unveil a new communications service for certain subscribers living on New York's Long Island.
The company said it will offer cable modems to 15,000 Long Island homes so that subscribers may connect their personal computers to the Internet.
Cable modems have more capacity than telephone lines and therefore can transmit the Internet's digital information at a higher speed, the cable company said.
Cablevision said it plans to release more details about the plan later on Tuesday.
